name: Commerce Shipping Pickup GLS CsomagPont
description: Adds GLS CsomagPont (Hungary) parcel-point pickup shipping to Drupal Commerce, with a dropdown (locality/address) selector and a Google-Maps-based map selector, built on the commerce_shipping_pickup_api framework.
project_description:
Provides pickup shipping service for GLS CsomagPont (Hungary), implementing the commerce_shipping_pickup_api framework module.

 Back to top 

 Providers and services 
 
 GLS CsomagPont (Hungary) - Csomagautomaták (Parcel machines) 
 

 
 A Google Maps JavaScript API key is required for the map to function.

See https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/get-api-key .

 The module has full localization to Hungarian, automatically installed on setup.

 I'm also available for sponsored development of similar submodules of other pickup service providers for interested parties. 

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install and enable the module through Composer:

 composer require drupal/commerce_shipping_pickup_gls_csomagpont

drush en commerce_shipping_pickup_gls_csomagpont 

 Add the new pickup_capable_shipping_information pane with the label Shipping information (look for the one that says Supports pickup in the summary) to your checkout flow or use the pre-built pickup checkout flow.

 Add and set up a new shipping method in your store configuration.

 Back to top
